  headline: The Clock That Stops at 3:17
  subheadline: Toy works tower clock puzzles the town
---
{{image:gazette-tower|The tower of Kessler & Daughters, from Station Road}}

**By our own reporter.** Since 12 December the tower clock of Kessler & Daughters has stopped at 3:17 every night. Each morning the hands stand still at the same minute, and each day the four o'clock whistle still blows on time.

{{char:hubert-dunn}}, who has wound the clock for thirty years, would not speak to the Gazette. "The clock runs in the day, and the whistle blows at four. That is what matters," said Mrs {{char:greta-kessler}}.

Some people in the town now call the old works haunted. A brass key or two has gone missing as well, we hear.

The works must send its biggest order yet, Rocket Rex robots for Hallworth's of London, before Christmas.

---

**NATURE NOTES. This week: the jackdaw.**

The jackdaw, a small crow with a grey neck, nests in towers and chimneys and carries off anything that shines. Keep your spoons in the drawer.

---

**Goods yard.** The station master reminds traders that the Wickfold goods yard closes at 5:45 on weekdays until the New Year.
